svg.title: VI. The grimoire
svg.desc: The grimoire. Web and Mobile Web Developer professional title (DWWM, French RNCP level 5) earned at Elan Formation in 2025, programme completed in one month; CDA programme (RNCP level 6) studied alongside, exam not taken; 12 freeCodeCamp and Microsoft certifications between 2024 and 2026; 20 solutions on Frontend Mentor. Before that: the 42 school selection pool (2024), a networks and telecoms degree, physics and chemistry, a computer science degree, and self-taught programming from around 13.
svg.text: DWWM · French RNCP level 5 · two-year degree
CDA · RNCP level 6 · exam not taken

text.tspan: JavaScript · Responsive Web Design · Python · Relational Database · Back-End
Development and APIs · Foundational C# with Microsoft · B1 English for
solutions published on Frontend Mentor, 385 points
